row.body: The cut potato and sample jar share red grit from the fertilizer test. They were bundled before the buses quit running.
row.title: Cut potato and sample jar, the early shift

sidecar.gloss: A personal trace connects a farm trial to symptoms before a later restriction.
sidecar.rival_reading: Emergency workers could have picked up the same red grit while responding near a field; this personal trace does not prove the trial caused the emergency.

row.body: A bottle of water and a strip of bandage have matching pencil marks. The marks are dates, not doses; someone was checking this bed before its occupant woke.
row.title: A label under the pillow

sidecar.gloss: An altered count or retained object was left at the scene.
sidecar.rival_reading: A response to an agricultural exposure could explain the same record or object.
